scenes.say: Who was the Qatar circuit built for? Not Formula One. Motorbikes.
MotoGP arrived in two thousand four, and held its first night race in two thousand eight.
F1 debuted in twenty twenty-one, Hamilton won. No race in twenty twenty-two because of the football World Cup.
It returned in twenty twenty-three on a ten-year deal, through twenty thirty-two.
Twenty twenty-three was brutal: Sargeant retired, Ocon was sick in his cockpit, tyres capped at eighteen laps.
Verstappen has won all three races since the return.
Now it's twenty-seven laps per set in a fifty-seven-lap race. So at least two pit stops.
Formula Two races here too. Leader Câmara drives for Haas, Tsolov is seven points back.
Check the race start in your own time zone on LapRadar.

title: Lusail: a circuit built for bikes, night racing and two pit stops in 2026
